caption:
has your vitamin C serum gone off?

Check the color. A clear L-ascorbic acid serum starts out almost colorless. Light makes it oxidize, and the oxidized form turns it yellow.

Clear or very pale: usually fine. Turning yellow: it's oxidizing. Oxidized vitamin C does less, and it can leave a yellowish tint on skin or stain clothes.

Keep it out of the light and close the cap tightly. Some serums are tinted on purpose or use more stable forms of vitamin C, so this check is for the clear ones.
